integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo the cited canonical-split/component-tree setup and the standard torus-knot crossing-number formula. Finite exact computation is included only as reproducibility evidence.
limitations: The theorem concerns canonical Lin--Spreer component sizes, not proven minimal triangulation complexity. The motivating preprint is recent, so later or unindexed parallel work remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp crossing-number envelope for canonical torus-knot component sizes
